answers.reason: The senate deals with central university strategy, whereas a junior professor only participates in the single body dedicated to their own core matters.
Budget allocation is a central administrative task and not the single designated place for a junior professor's matters.
As a fixed-term professor, the junior professor does not sit on the committee for permanent appointments, since each member participates in only one body matching their specific matters.
The faculty council is chaired by the dean and handles overarching faculty governance rather than the specific matters of a junior professor.
The study commission deals with degree programmes, which is separate from the junior professor's primary focus on building a research group.
The examination board handles student credit and appeal matters, which is outside the junior professor's specific purview.

Because the junior professor is building up a research group and every member takes part in one body where their specific matters are decided, the internal research funding round is their designated place.
Every member participates in only one body, and rewriting module descriptions is not the primary domain of a junior professor building a research group.
Procuring teaching laboratory equipment is a separate matter from building a research group, and members only sit in one body.
Planning the orientation week for new students is a student-related matter, not the designated domain of a junior professor.
